versions.name: Guajataka Scout Reservation (Camp Guajataka)

features.note: Backpacking routes and guided expeditions from camp.
A fleet of 35 canoes on Lake Guajataca.
A staffed infirmary open at all hours.
The camp's Nature Lodge, used for nature classes.
Two pools staffed by certified aquatics personnel.
Lake Guajataca frontage with an observation tower.

versions.summary: Puerto Rico Council's traditional summer camp on Guajataca Lake in San Sebastian, serving Scouts BSA with merit badges and rank advancement (Tenderfoot, Second Class, First Class), along with Cub Scouts and Venturing.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/661-108970); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
